definitions: Thinking or tending to think about the good aspects of a situation; optimistic.
Characterised by the presence or possession of features rather than their absence.
Showing the expected or desired result.
Having a value greater than zero.
Relating to or denoting the first degree of the comparison of adjectives and adverbs, e.g. ‘big’, ‘happily’.
examples: She has a very positive outlook on life.
The test results were positive for the virus.
We need to make a positive contribution.
